> - Manipulating physical objects doesn't really work unless the game is suspended. This is not new, and it used to happen when editing position values via the remote inspector, for example. This could be worked around later own.

To work around this, you could have an option or key modifier to automatically suspend the game when starting the drag operation, and resume it when the drag operation ends.
That's a good idea, but I also have a plan to make the dragging requests be delayed to the physics frame in the runtime side. Will decide on which approach to take after this is merged.

> From other bugs, the temp pivot (Shift+drag in pivot tool) can't be set in the editor, only at runtime. Also it doesn't reset when selection changes.

Fixed.

> I see lots of functionality moved to CanvasItemManipulator, that isn't used at runtime. E.g. grid, ruler and guides. I assume this is for some technical reason?

Because the components for those functions are intertwined with the other elements, so they needed to be brought together.

Tested this and have some suggestions for improvements. There seem to be a lot of things broken in its current state, too. - The order of the actions in the select mode tooltip are not the same as the order of the tools in the bar: - The shortcuts (W, E, R, etc) to select the different tools don't work for me. - The PR states that [Ctrl/Cmd] + [Z] should work but I couldn't get it to work. What's strange is that when I undo, nothing happens and there's _no message in the output panel until I click_, and then it'll output "Can't undo while mouse buttons are pressed.". If I undo multiple times, then my click will spawn all the output messages at once. Anyway, something fishy is going on: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4eee69e7-8bd3-4982-867a-bbe98734c87d - The remote scene tree is empty for me until I press the remote tab button or I toggle between the Remote and Local tabs, after which it will show up (and continue to show up): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a82f8a2e-a953-4bec-a3dc-235bed18e187 - If I click anywhere in the view when I have the move / rotate / scale tool selected, even if I didn't move my mouse at all and thus didn't apply any changes to the transform, a message is outputted that I moved / rotated / scaled the thing. This is in contrast with how it works in the regular 2D view where you'll only get that output message when you've actually made a change, and I think that makes more sense. - Moving the cursor out of the view in Pan mode leads to weird jittery behavior as it seemingly doesn't wrap correctly: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47b9ef91-5286-44a3-a6fc-60640d6445df - I just learned about how 'list selectable nodes' tool doesn't actually show a list at all when there's only 1 node to select, and instead it would just select that one node. I find this behavior quite confusing, as IMO it should just show the popup with the one option. - 'list selectable nodes' tool menu doesn't show at the mouse location: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3fea1ebd-88c9-4ec8-afb7-17532ffd2857 I can give this another try when you've addressed these!

> The order of the actions in the select mode tooltip are not the same as the order of the tools in the bar That's exactly how they are ordered in the canvas editor on `master`, so unrelated to this PR. > The shortcuts (W, E, R, etc) to select the different tools don't work for me. Can't reproduce that on my end. In fact, it actually works better than in `master`, where some shortcuts are failing for that toolbar (e.g. V). > The PR states that [Ctrl/Cmd] + [Z] should work but I couldn't get it to work. What's strange is that when I undo, nothing happens and there's no message in the output panel until I click, and then it'll output "Can't undo while mouse buttons are pressed.". If I undo multiple times, then my click will spawn all the output messages at once. Anyway, something fishy is going on Works fine on my end: [Screencast_20260922_124201.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dbe992fc-4665-4193-8d8f-8320d33d7f4e) > The remote scene tree is empty for me until I press the remote tab button or I toggle between the Remote and Local tabs, after which it will show up (and continue to show up) I can reproduce this on `master`, so that regression was caused by something else. **UPDATE:** Fixed by #123730. > If I click anywhere in the view when I have the move / rotate / scale tool selected, even if I didn't move my mouse at all and thus didn't apply any changes to the transform, a message is outputted that I moved / rotated / scaled the thing. This is in contrast with how it works in the regular 2D view where you'll only get that output message when you've actually made a change, and I think that makes more sense. ~Good catch, I will fix that.~ Fixed. > Moving the cursor out of the view in Pan mode leads to weird jittery behavior as it seemingly doesn't wrap correctly Remote pan auto-wrapping is also a mess on `master`. On Wayland, it completely ignores mouse input once it leaves the game area, I even opened an issue about it: #121330. Could you please try doing the same on `master`? > I just learned about how 'list selectable nodes' tool doesn't actually show a list at all when there's only 1 node to select, and instead it would just select that one node. I find this behavior quite confusing, as IMO it should just show the popup with the one option. Exact same behavior as the canvas editor on `master`, so unrelated to this PR. And honestly, I think this is better than making the user click twice for nothing. > 'list selectable nodes' tool menu doesn't show at the mouse location Shows correctly on my end. Also, I don't think I even touched the popup position behavior on this PR.
